subject: Vendr portal: admin rotation + evidence governance checklist
messages:
From: ACME Security Portal <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr access + admin handoff request

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from Acme's security team — we're finishing up our SIG/CAIQ review and need to add a Redwood admin to our Vendr profile so we can hand over the evidence bundle for SOC 2 refresh. We currently have one owner on the account (Jackson Miller) and will rotate primary admin to your org.

What we need from you:
- Confirm the email for the new Vendr admin (preferably an organizational address)
- Provide the name of the person who will be the long-term evidence owner vs the short-term rotation contact
- Permission window for when we can transfer ownership (we prefer a 48-hour overlap)

We can upload the Type II report and a manifest CSV to a presigned S3 location after the admin is added.

Thanks,
Jackson Miller
Security Operations — Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

Cc: Jackson Miller <jackson.miller@acme-corp.com>

Subject: Re: Vendr access + admin handoff request

Thanks Jackson — looping in Ben and Irene to coordinate the admin rotation and evidence intake. Planned approach below; please chime if this doesn't match Acme's workflow.

Plan (high level)
- Ben will be the short-term admin to accept the Vendr invite and verify evidence links (2 day overlap).
- Irene will be the long-term evidence owner and will be responsible for annual refreshes and proving possession for the SOC artifacts.
- We'll confirm the transfer window for 2027-03-22 09:00 - 2027-03-24 09:00 PT (48 hours).

Ben/Irene — can you accept the invite when it lands and validate the S3 manifest + sample artifacts? For the drive links please ensure we get canonical object keys and that any sensitive system logs are redacted per our retention policy.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security Programs — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 07:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr access + admin handoff request

Sounds good — I'll be the temporary admin and accept the invite.

Action items for me:
- Accept Vendr admin invite and confirm user role mapping (owner -> admin -> evidence-uploader)
- Validate manifest CSV (I'll check schema: path, checksum, object-type, ttl)
- Verify that SOC 2 PDF is the final signed Type II (no redactions required)
- If anything looks off, I'll open a support ticket with Acme and loop legal/IR as needed

Confirmed — Ben accepted the invite and I've added Irene as evidence owner in our runbook. Steps completed today:
- Accepted Vendr admin invite (Ben)
- Validated manifest CSV schema and sampled three objects (checksums match)
- Downloaded SOC2 Type II PDF and placed canonical copy in our secure Drive folder (link below)
- Created a 2-week reminder for evidence rotation and added a note to the HubSpot deal (HUBSPOT-DEAL-12345) to surface during renewal

Next steps for Acme:
- Please confirm if you want Redwood to retain a signed Letter of Attestation in our records; otherwise we'll rely on the Type II report you provided.
- If you plan monthly incremental evidence uploads, please let us know the expected cadence so we can set up automated ingestion via the Vendr API.

Thanks for the speedy handoff. I'll follow up with a short playbook (vendr_admin_transfer_playbook.md) summarizing the handback steps and TTL for presigned links.
